item.title: Fix window.py so all inputs are handled correctly
item.brief: In this repository, `python3 -m unittest` currently fails. Find and fix the underlying bug in `window.py` so every existing test passes, without changing any tests. Make the function correct for every valid and invalid input according to its intended contract, not merely the currently tested examples; inspect edge cases and define/handle them consistently. Run `python3 -m unittest` after the fix. Commit the fix on the local branch; do not push.

pr.body: Updated window.py to use the inclusive final start index and operator.index for integer-like size validation. Nonpositive integer sizes continue to raise ValueError; non-integer sizes raise TypeError. Verified with python3 -m unittest (3 passed) and git diff --check. No tests were changed.
pr.summary: Fixed sliding_windows to return every contiguous window, including the final one and the full-length window. Before: 2 unittest failures; now: all 3 tests pass.
